title: What's new
description: What customers see in ThinkZap's What's new tab. Nothing reaches them without review.
awaitingReview_one: {{count}} update awaiting review: done, not yet available to customers.
awaitingReview_other: {{count}} updates awaiting review: done, not yet available to customers.
pendingChangesHint: Saved text or image that customers don't see yet.
emptyDescription: Create the first one. Once published, it shows in ThinkZap's What's new tab.
noResultsDescription: Pick another situation to see the rest.

detail.pendingBannerDescription: Customers keep seeing the published version until you publish the changes.
detail.awaitingReviewNotice: Done. Customers still see this update under “Coming soon”: publish it as available when it's ready.

content.title: Content
content.incompleteHint: Fill in title and description in all three languages to publish.
content.descriptionHint: Plain text. Line breaks show to customers.

image.title: Image
image.hint: Optional. PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB. Shown at the top of the card.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How customers will see the card in {{locale}}, with the text being edited.

task.title: Bitrix task
task.description: Completing the task completes the update, and the other way round. Nothing changes for customers.
task.awaitingApproval: Awaiting approval in Bitrix: completion was sent and waits for the task creator to approve it.
task.searchInput: ID, #ID or part of the title
task.searchHint: By number: any project. By text: up to 20 tasks from the products project, newest first.
task.typeToSearch: Type the ID or part of the title.
task.outsideGroupWarning: This task belongs to another Bitrix project. It can still be linked.
task.createHint: The task is created in the products project with the Portuguese title and description and a link to this update.

publish.title: Publish under “Coming soon”?
publish.description: Customers start seeing this update in ThinkZap's “Coming soon” tab.

publish-available.title: Publish as available?
publish-available.description: Customers start seeing this update under “Available now”, with its availability date.

publish-changes.title: Publish the changes?
publish-changes.description: Customers start seeing the text and image being edited. The availability date doesn't change.

discard-changes.title: Discard the changes?
discard-changes.description: Editing goes back to what customers see today. What was changed is lost.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this update?
unpublish.description: It goes back to draft and disappears from customers' What's new tab. The availability date is kept.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.description: The draft is deleted for good. This can't be undone.

result.savePending: Changes saved. Customers only see them after “Publish changes”.
result.completeAwaitingApproval: Completion sent to Bitrix. The task awaits the creator's approval, and the update stays pending until then.

errors.previously-available: This update was available before. Use “Publish as available” to bring it back with its original date.
errors.not-done: Mark the update as done before publishing it as available.
errors.published-before: Only drafts that were never published can be deleted. Unpublish it to hide it from customers.
errors.task-already-set: This update already has a task. Unlink it before linking another.
errors.task-already-linked: Task #{{taskId}} is already linked to another update.
errors.task-already-linked-open: Open the update using the task
errors.tasks-sync-disabled: Sync with Bitrix tasks is turned off in this environment.
errors.missing-locales: Fill in title and description in: {{locales}}.
errors.invalid-image: The file isn't a valid PNG or JPEG image.
errors.invalid-image-type: The image must be a PNG or JPEG file.
errors.task-not-found: Task #{{taskId}} wasn't found in CRMThink's Bitrix.
errors.responsible-required: Choose who is responsible for the task.
errors.crmthink-tasks-unavailable: CRMThink's Bitrix didn't respond. Nothing was changed.
errors.image-storage-unavailable: Image upload is unavailable right now. The rest of the update still works.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.not-found: Update not found. It may have been deleted.
